property_summary: For any player, any guess hash, and any block number at which they lock in, if the player calls settle() in the same block as the lock block (guesses[msg.sender].block), the reference must revert and the mutant must succeed, so the number of successful settle() calls in that immediate block must be zero on the reference and can be one on the mutant.
change_summary: Change the block-number guard from strictly greater than to greater-than-or-equal, allowing settle in the same block as the recorded lock block.
